C0901.title: Yangzhou Police Dismantle Online Game Account Trading Black Market, 16 Sentenced for Account Theft and Laundering
C0901.summary: A player in Yangzhou had his Dungeon Fighter Online account stripped of in-game currency and equipment. Police investigation uncovered a black market chain involving phishing site creators, account thieves, virtual asset launderers, and resellers.
